newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Freight Links buys cranes for S$33.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Freight Links buys cranes for S$33.2 mln.

text.p: Freight forwarders Freight Links Express Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it had purchased 56 brand new cranes for a total of Singapore $33.2 million.
The company said in a statement the first cranes would be delivered in April 1997. The remainder were scheduled to be delivered within the next 12 months.
The purchases would be financed by internal funds and by bank borrowings. It said the cranes were bought from several private companies.
The transaction would have no material impact on group profits or net tangible assets for its 1997 financial year.
